authoritative: Source: the Secretary of State's official 1998 state Senate returns by county, whose county rows add up to each printed district total; they replace Klarner's district totals.
title: State Senate, November 3, 1998 general election, by county

pages.hint: The page holds several district tables; read only the table headed DISTRICT 1. One row per county in that table, with one column per candidate number 1, 2, 3 across the page and the last column Write-Ins. Label each column from the CANDIDATES key of that table: column 2 is Tommy G. Haun. Columns whose candidate name is blank are zero and are left out. Include the DISTRICT TOTAL row as the total.
